mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crf_attachment (record_id, file_id, file_name, created_by, deleted, created_at) VALUES (#{recordId}, #{fileId}, #{fileName}, #{createdBy}, #{deleted}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM crf_attachment WHERE record_id = #{recordId} AND file_id = #{fileId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM crf_attachment WHERE file_id = #{fileId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM crf_attachment WHERE record_id = #{recordId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crf_attachment WHERE record_id = #{recordId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE crf_attachment SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
